title: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?
question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) AS Year
FROM yearmonth AS T2
INNER JOIN CustomerCurrency AS T1 ON T2.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1
